name: Benjamin Sun
life: “I still remember recognizing a former pupil by their perfect dive.” On Friday, near the window at Night Shift Donuts, Benjamin knows when the going-home crowd and the coming-to-work crowd will both be there.
voice: I taught her to swim at Pier Beach. I didn't recognize the quiet uniformed girl with her hair dry.
appearance: Benjamin has fine brows over wide-set eyes. Look for a swept fringe and a closely clipped nape. On an ordinary day, the familiar outfit is a faded indigo overshirt with a little coil of soft measuring tape. In conversation Benjamin draws breath as if to speak and lets someone else go first.
personality: Benjamin loves a well-told anecdote and distrusts the neat ending. The parts Benjamin remembers are the interruptions, unfinished jobs and people who had to go back to work halfway through.
agenda: To visit the former pupil before departure.
family: Jamie Calloway is Benjamin’s older cousin. Benjamin can always ask for five minutes alone. Jamie asks before bringing somebody along. It keeps a conversation between two people from unexpectedly turning into a family committee. Asked about *The sheltered corner*, Jamie says, “Our porch got quieter. I miss knowing school is out by the sudden noise.”
connections: Drew Ferraro. Wet hair and a school blazer remind two helpers how differently they have known the same child.
